cities.name: Zagreb
interests: History & Upper Town 🏛️ — Medieval alleys, old squares and charming historic corners.
Parks & Green Spaces 🌳 — Elegant 19th-century promenades and peaceful city parks.
Urban Culture & Street Life 🎨 — Creative museums, quirky cafés and vibrant cultural spots.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Zagreb’s classics such as warm štrukli, hearty soups, roasted turkey with mlinci and bakery pastries. Comforting, local and full of home-style flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Upper Town: Wander medieval lanes, peaceful corners and the iconic tiled roof at St. Mark’s Square. → ⛪ Zagreb Cathedral: Gothic towers and calm interior. → ☕ Coffee in Tkalča Street: Zagreb’s liveliest café zone. Afternoon: 🌳 Lenuci’s Green Horseshoe: Stroll through elegant city parks such as Zrinjevac and Mažuranić Square. → 🎭 Museum of Broken Relationships: A quirky cultural gem. → 🍽️ Lunch: Štrukli, roasted turkey with mlinci, hearty soups or vegetarian options. Sunset: 🌅 Jarun Lake or Bundek: Calm reflections and golden-hour lakeside views. Night: 🌃 Evening Walk Through the Center: Lights, dessert cafés, street performers and a cozy local vibe.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms around Cvjetni Square and Zrinjevac.
🌳 Maksimir Park: Fresh greenery and quiet lakes.
☕ Sunny café terraces across downtown streets.
🌞 Lakeside breezes at Jarun or Bundek.
🍦 Ice cream under the Zrinjevac trees.
🌅 Upper Town sunset viewpoints.
🍁 Fall colors in Maksimir and the Green Horseshoe.
🎨 Museum visits for cozy indoor afternoons.
🥐 Seasonal pastries from local bakeries.
🎄 Tomislav Square ice rink and festive stalls.
✨ Magical Zrinjevac lights.
☕ Warm drinks in old-town cafés.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams cover the entire center and are fast for cross-city travel.
🚶 Upper Town is best explored on foot due to narrow streets.
🚌 Buses connect lakes, outer neighborhoods and parks.
📱 Use the 'ZET Zagreb' app for tram arrivals and route planning.

cities.name: Split
interests: Roman Heritage 🏛️ — Ancient palace walls and dramatic stone courtyards.
Sea Views & Promenades 🌊 — Blue horizons, breezy walkways and harbor scenes.
Mediterranean Culture 🌿 — Warm coastal life, cafés and local markets.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Dalmatian classics like pašticada, grilled fish, mussels in buzara sauce, seafood risotto and light Mediterranean veggie plates — fresh and aromatic.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Diocletian’s Palace: Explore Roman walls, Peristyle Square and maze-like stone alleys. → ⛪ St. Domnius Cathedral & Bell Tower: Climb for incredible panoramic views. → ☕ Coffee on the Riva Promenade: Palm trees and sea breeze. Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town Wander: Marble alleys, artisan shops and charming squares. → 🍽️ Lunch: Seafood dishes, pašticada, grilled fish or veggie plates. Sunset: 🌅 Marjan Hill Viewpoint: Legendary golden-hour views over the Adriatic. Night: 🌃 Riva Evening Walk: Soft lights, gelato stands and a calm seaside atmosphere.

ideas: 🌿 Forest paths and viewpoints on Marjan Hill.
🌸 Blooming Old Town courtyards.
☕ Sunny Riva terraces with sea breeze.
🏖️ Swimming at Bačvice Beach or Kašjuni.
🍦 Gelato in palace alleyways.
🌅 Vidilica sunset views on Marjan.
🍁 Cooler Marjan hikes.
🐟 Warm seafood meals in cozy konobas.
🎭 Museums and cultural spots with fewer crowds.
🎄 Riva Christmas stalls and live music.
✨ Festive lights in Pjaca and Old Town streets.
☕ Warm drinks with sea views.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 The palace complex is pedestrian-only and perfect for walking.
🚌 Local buses connect beaches, viewpoints and outer districts.
🚕 Taxis and ride apps are widely available near the Riva.
⛴️ Ferries to nearby islands depart from the main port next to Old Town.

cities.name: Dubrovnik
interests: City Walls & Fortresses 🧱 — Panoramic walks and iconic medieval towers.
Sea Views 🌊 — Deep blue horizons and dramatic coastline.
Medieval Old Town 🏰 — Marble streets, arches and centuries of history.
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy seafood risotto, mussels, grilled fish, buzara dishes and Mediterranean vegetarian plates — fresh and perfect for coastal evenings.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🧱 City Walls: Gorgeous morning light and fewer crowds. → 🏰 Old Town: Marble streets and picturesque squares. → ☕ Coffee on Stradun. Afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: Pine forests, cliffs, wildlife and swimming spots. → 🍽️ Lunch: Seafood plates, mussels or light Mediterranean dishes. Sunset: 🌅 Fort Lovrijenac: Dramatic sunset over sea and stone walls. Night: 🌃 Stradun Evening Walk: Soft lights, gelato and relaxing coastal atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Quiet Old Town mornings before peak season.
🌊 Clear Adriatic views and fresh sea breeze.
🌿 Lokrum greenery returning after winter.
🏖️ Swimming at Banje Beach.
🏝️ Island trips and boat tours.
🌅 Sunset viewpoints from fortresses and promenades.
🍁 Warm colors across medieval alleys.
🥘 Comforting Dalmatian meals in cozy taverns.
🎭 Exhibitions, cultural programs and concerts.
🎄 Old Town Advent market.
✨ Stradun shining under festive lights.
☕ Warm drinks in narrow, quiet streets.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old Town is fully pedestrian — walking is essential.
🚌 Buses connect outer districts with the Pile Gate entrance.
⛴️ Lokrum boats run every 30 minutes in season.
🚡 Cable car to Srđ Hill offers spectacular views.

cities.name: Vukovar
interests: History & Heritage 🏛️ — Museums, baroque manor houses and memorial sites.
Danube Scenery 🌊 — Wide riverside horizons and peaceful promenades.
Museums & Reflection 🕊️ — Educational and meaningful places to visit.
cities.local_food_tip: Slavonian dishes such as čobanac, fiš paprikaš, river fish, hearty soups and rustic pastries — warm, flavorful and authentic.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🕊️ Memorial Center: Meaningful and educational start to the day. → 🏛️ Eltz Manor: Elegant baroque museum by the river. → ☕ Riverside Coffee along the Danube. Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Long peaceful riverside walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: Slavonian stews, river fish dishes or warm vegetarian soups. Sunset: 🌅 Wide river horizon glowing in golden light. Night: 🌃 Quiet center walk with soft street lighting.

🌸 Blossoms in local parks.

🎄 Riverbank Advent stalls.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Most key sites lie along the Danube and are walkable.
🚌 Local buses connect neighborhoods and the town outskirts.
🚗 Taxis are affordable for longer distances.
📍 The river promenade is the easiest orientation point.

cities.name: Ilok
interests: Wine Culture 🍇 — Historic cellars and hillside vineyards.
Castle Views 🏰 — Hilltop panoramas overlooking the Danube.
Danube Scenery 🌊 — Calm riverside paths and wide horizons.
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy hearty Slavonian dishes, river fish specialties, dumpling soups and rustic comfort meals — perfect with Ilok’s regional cuisine.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Ilok Castle: Hilltop panoramas over vineyards and the Danube. → 🍇 Medieval Wine Cellars (non-alcoholic friendly tours): Stone corridors and historic barrels. → ☕ Coffee on a viewpoint terrace. Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Quiet riverside walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: Rustic Slavonian dishes, soups or vegetarian plates. Sunset: 🌅 Fiery sunsets over vineyards and the river. Night: 🌃 Peaceful old-town stroll.
